zones.creative: P, Tv, Av, M, Fv, B or C1-C3
zones.note: Positions are for Creative Zone modes (P/Tv/Av/M/Fv/B/C1-C3). In A+ and SCN the camera hides some tabs and every Creative-only item, so rows below a hidden item move up.

items.label: Image quality
items.desc: File type and size for stills: RAW, C-RAW, JPEG/HEIF and their sizes, or RAW+JPEG.

items.label: Dual Pixel RAW
items.desc: Records extra Dual Pixel data in RAW files so you can fine-tune them in Canon software later. Files get much bigger.

items.label: {stills}Cropping/aspect ratio
items.desc: Shoot full-frame, 1.6x crop (APS-C), or with a 1:1, 4:3 or 16:9 aspect ratio.

items.label: Digital tele-conv
items.desc: Digital teleconverter: in-camera digital zoom for stills (crops and enlarges the center of the frame).

items.label: Expo.comp./AEB
items.desc: Exposure compensation plus auto exposure bracketing (AEB) for stills.

items.label: {stills}ISO speed settings
topics: ISO Speed Range When Set Manually
ISO Speed Range Used with ISO Auto
Minimum Shutter Speed for ISO Auto
items.desc: ISO for stills: the manual ISO range, the Auto ISO range, and the minimum shutter speed Auto ISO will allow.

items.label: Anti-flicker shoot.
items.desc: Detects flickering lights (e.g. fluorescent) and times each shot to the brightest moment so exposure and color stay even.

items.label: HF anti-flicker shooting
items.desc: High-frequency anti-flicker: finds a shutter speed that avoids banding from fast-flickering LED lights.

items.label: External Speedlite control
topics: EL/EX Series Speedlites for EOS Cameras
Canon Speedlites Other Than the EL/EX Series
items.desc: Settings for a flash on the hot shoe: firing, E-TTL metering, flash exposure compensation, sync and the flash's own custom functions.

items.label: Metering mode
items.desc: How the camera measures light: evaluative, partial, spot or center-weighted average.

items.label: Detect priority AE while AF
items.desc: Weights exposure toward the subject the AF has detected (face, animal, vehicle).

items.label: Color mode
items.desc: Picture Style (Standard, Portrait, Landscape, Monochrome...) or Custom Picture / Canon Log, plus sharpness, contrast, saturation and tone tweaks.

items.label: Color space
items.desc: Color space for stills: sRGB or Adobe RGB.

items.label: Clarity
items.desc: Adds or reduces mid-tone edge contrast (like a clarity slider in editing software).

items.label: HDR shooting (PQ)
items.desc: Records HDR stills/movies with the PQ curve (HEIF for stills) for viewing on HDR screens.

items.label: HDR Mode
items.desc: In-camera HDR stills: merges several exposures into one image with more dynamic range.

items.label: Auto Lighting Optimizer
opts: Disabled in M or B modes
items.desc: Automatically lifts shadows and corrects contrast in JPEG/HEIF images. Off, Low, Standard or High.

items.label: Highlight tone priority
items.desc: Protects highlight detail (raises the minimum ISO). Enable or Enhanced.

items.label: VR clear mode
items.desc: Optimizes image quality for footage shot with EOS VR lenses.

items.label: White balance setting
topics: Registration from an image on a card
items.desc: White balance presets, Kelvin, custom WB, WB correction/bracketing and how quickly Auto WB reacts.

items.label: Lens aberration correction
topics: General Precautions on Lens Aberration Correction
items.desc: Lens corrections: vignetting, distortion, chromatic aberration, diffraction, Digital Lens Optimizer and focus-breathing correction.

items.label: Long exp. noise reduction
items.desc: Dark-frame noise reduction for exposures of 1 second or longer. Doubles the wait after each long shot.

items.label: High ISO speed NR
items.desc: Noise reduction strength for high-ISO JPEG/HEIF images (and movies).

items.label: Dust Delete Data
items.desc: Captures a reference of sensor dust so Canon software can erase the spots from images later.

items.label: Multiple exposure
topics: Merging Multiple Exposures with a JPEG Image Recorded on the Card
Checking and Deleting Multiple Exposures During Shooting
items.desc: Blends several shots into one image (additive, average, bright or dark).

items.label: Focus bracketing
items.desc: Shoots a burst while stepping focus, for focus stacking. Can also merge the frames in camera (depth composite).

items.label: Drive mode
items.desc: Single shot, high-speed/low-speed continuous (burst) or self-timer.

items.label: Pre-cont. shooting
items.desc: Pre-continuous (pre-capture): buffers frames while you half-press, so the burst starts slightly before you fully press.

items.label: Interval timer
items.desc: Intervalometer: takes a set number of stills at a fixed interval.

items.label: Bulb timer
items.desc: Sets a fixed bulb exposure time (e.g. 2 minutes) so you don't need to hold the shutter button.

items.label: Silent shutter function
items.desc: Silent shooting: uses the electronic shutter and turns off sounds.

items.label: Shutter mode
items.desc: Mechanical, electronic first-curtain or fully electronic shutter.

items.label: Release shutter without card
items.desc: Whether the camera can take a picture with no card inserted. Disable it so you never shoot without a card.

items.label: IS (Image Stabilizer) mode
items.desc: In-body/lens image stabilization settings, including Digital IS and Movie IS, and the focal length for non-communicating lenses.

items.label: Metering timer
items.desc: How long exposure info stays active after you release the shutter button.

items.label: Add distance data to JPEGs
items.desc: Adds depth data to JPEGs (with Dual Pixel RAW) for making 3D models in Canon's Dual Pixel 3D Converter.

items.label: Image review
items.desc: Shows the picture right after you take it, and for how long (off, 2 s, 4 s, 8 s, hold).

items.label: High speed display
items.desc: Shows the live view between frames during high-speed continuous shooting.

items.label: Display simulation
items.desc: Whether the screen/EVF previews exposure and depth of field (WYSIWYG).

items.label: OVF sim. view assist
items.desc: OVF simulation: shows a wider-tone, optical-viewfinder-like view in high-contrast scenes.

items.desc: View assist: shows a normal-looking image on the screen while shooting HDR PQ or Canon Log.
